care.title: Notes from the greenhouse
care.intro: Practical tips for keeping your plants healthy and thriving at home
care.body1: Rare aroids are sensitive to excess water. Let the soil dry well between waterings and always check its condition before watering again
care.body2: Humidity is especially important for tropical plants. A humidifier, enclosed cabinet, or consistently humid environment can help maintain better conditions
care.body3: New leaves are a good sign of healthy growth. If growth slows down, check the light, watering routine, and humidity around the plant

about.title: A small plant house
about.intro: Understory began in 2019 and grew into a greenhouse near Portland
about.body1: We sell plants only once they have a healthy, well-developed root system. Cuttings are never sold as established plants
about.body2: Every order is packed specifically for the plant, taking its size, condition, and journey into account to help it travel safely
about.body3: We intentionally grow in small batches so every plant receives enough time, attention, and proper care before leaving the greenhouse

guarantee.title: 90-day root guarantee
guarantee.intro: If your plant doesn't settle in within 90 days, we'll help find the right solution and get it back on track
guarantee.body1: Contact support with your order number so we can quickly review the details and help with the next steps
guarantee.body2: The guarantee covers root development and normal shipping stress, including the plant's natural adjustment to a new environment
guarantee.body3: If a replacement is needed, it will come from the next available batch of the same or a comparable plant

shipping.title: Shipping with climate in mind
shipping.intro: Every order is prepared with the plant, weather, and entire journey in mind to help reduce shipping stress
shipping.body1: We ship Monday through Wednesday so plants spend as little time as possible in warehouses or transit centers over the weekend
shipping.body2: Seasonal protection is selected based on the destination, weather, and current shipping conditions
shipping.body3: Orders over $150 ship free. Smaller orders have a flat $18 shipping fee

contact.title: Talk to us
contact.intro: Questions about an order, plant care, or your collection? We're happy to help
contact.body1: This is currently a frontend demo, so the contact form isn't connected to a live messaging service
contact.body2: For questions about an order, include your order number so we can quickly find the relevant details
